result:
I wrote the review report with verdict `fix`. I made no code edits.

The main findings:
- **Token table too tall:** the new Figma-variable table on the tokens page is about 1860px tall at 400px wide. It pushes the page's real demos about two screens down, and its Relation column wraps heavily.
- **Requirements 3 and 4 can't be checked:** requirement 3 is the `owner_note` decision on mocking up in Figma. Requirement 4 is the note to the Figma agent's inbox and its recorded reply. Neither appears in the diff or the task log. The recommendation is in `round-trip.md`.
- **Table has no picture:** it is 24 rows of text with no colour swatches. That goes against "show, don't tell."
- **`round-trip.md` is long:** it is 107 lines against the brief's "one screen."

Requirement 1 holds: the Figma file lists 36 pages and the inventory lists 36. Coded 6, doc-only 17 and not coded 13 add up to 36. Requirement 2 holds too: the token map is rendered on the tokens page, and `doc/next.md` covers the sync. The report also notes that the band measurements at 1200 and above are unreliable (negative `y`, zero ink), so I judged those widths from the shots.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/figma-to-code/review/report.md`.
